envelopes.transformation: Only remove reviewed outer SQL transaction envelope/comments before BEGIN and final COMMIT; keep body bytes verbatim; ledger stores complete original file text.

sourceAuthority: Registry raw path+full SHA+body range+body SHA; offsets are code-reviewed registry tuples, never arbitrary plan slice arguments. Files remain byte-identical.
scanner: New independently reviewed bounded top-level lexical scanner handles comments, ordinary/escaped strings, quoted identifiers and dollar-quoted bodies; reject malformed/unconsumed text, psql meta commands, nested top-level transaction control and unsafe top-level commands. Not a full SQL parser and not authority for arbitrary SQL.
unsafe: Reject CONCURRENTLY, VACUUM, ALTER SYSTEM, CREATE/DROP DATABASE, transaction-controlling CALL, COPY PROGRAM/file, unreviewed extension/network/external commands at top level. PL/pgSQL BEGIN/END inside pinned quoted definitions is not transaction control.000 DO block catalog checks+REVOKE and002 DO constraint replacement are explicitly reviewed transactional effects.

migrationReview.000: Catalog pre/post checks +single transactional REVOKE, no body/global ACL mutation
migrationReview.001: Transactional function creation/replacement/private ACLs. Agent DML occurs only in stored function bodies, not by installing definitions. No Agent routine is invoked.
migrationReview.002: Transactional function DDL, exact constraint replacement and private ACLs. Publication DML in stored definitions only; no publish call or business row rewrite. Constraint validation may read existing rows during a later separately approved install.

sequence: fresh RO preflight receipt, rollback RO transaction
open guarded apply session READ COMMITTED; BEGIN; fixed session/lock/statement timeouts; standard_conforming_strings=on
LOCK TABLE supabase_migrations.schema_migrations IN SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE MODE (5s bounded wait)
recheck target identity, exact ledger/prefix/absences and all plan preconditions in this transaction; compare fresh RO capture and sealed baseline
capture catalog before set; execute ONLY hashed envelope body once
insert exactly one full-source ledger row; run all typed in-transaction postchecks and scope-delta checks
COMMIT exactly once; emit nonce-bound server commit ACK only after COMMIT; no next migration
separate fresh READ ONLY verification; compare old ledger rows/new exact source, target postconditions, protected catalogs; preserve original commit receipt even if verification differs

concurrency.rationale: Reuse existing R5B advisory namespace/key so cooperative old/new runners serialize; do not mutate old runner.
concurrency.ledgerLock: SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE prevents concurrent ledger writers
concurrency.limits: Advisory lock cannot block arbitrary privileged out-of-band DDL. Approved maintenance window must exclude external migration/ACL operators; fresh/under-lock/precommit/postcommit catalogs detect drift and STOP, no claim of universal DDL fencing.

freshness.approval: Window valid at dispatch and before COMMIT; operator authorization single-use; expiries never extended automatically
freshness.toctou: Same apply session rechecks after lock; READ COMMITTED gets fresh statement snapshots; original file/plan bytes read once and retained/hash-checked; recheck runtime/backup identities at dispatch.

failure: No automatic down migration, GRANT, ledger deletion, retry or fallback. Missing commit ACK => COMMIT_UNKNOWN until independent human-reviewed resolution; later RO result is a new receipt, not rewritten commit history.
